an10.116:1.1: athakho ājino paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an10.116:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.116:2.1: amhākaṃ bho gotama paṇḍito nāma sabrahmacārī
an10.116:2.2: tena pañcamattāni cittaṭṭhānasatāni yehi aññatitthiyā upāraddhāva jānanti upāraddhasmāti.
an10.116:3.3: etassa bhagavā kālo etassa sugata kālo
an10.116:3.4: yaṃ bhagavā bhāseyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
an10.116:4.1: tenahi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.
an10.116:4.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.116:5.1: idha bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti
an10.116:5.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti
an10.116:5.3: paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bhoti
an10.116:6.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti
an10.116:6.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti
an10.116:6.3: paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bhoti
an10.116:7.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikañca vādaṃ adhammikañca vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti
an10.116:7.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bhoti idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bhoti idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti tena ca dhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti tena sā dhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti
an10.116:7.3: paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bhoti
an10.116:8.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.116:8.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.116:9.1: katamo ca bhikkhave adhammo katamo ca dhammo katamo ca anattho katamo ca attho
an10.116:9.4: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.116:9.5: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho
an10.116:11.3: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho
an10.116:11.4: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho
an10.116:12.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca
an10.116:12.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.116:12.4: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
